claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.last_charge_conditional
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing last_charge_roll destroys on the threshold roll. The Staff of Power's last-charge rule has two distinct outcomes: on 1, the item degrades (retains +2 weapon bonus only, loses all other properties — not destroyed); on 20, the item regains 1d8+2 charges. Neither the degradation semantics nor the bonus-recharge branch are expressible in the current destruction policy surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.pool_size_times
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike deals Force damage equal to 16× (for the caster) or 4× (for other creatures) the number of charges remaining in the staff at the moment of activation. No current DiceAmount variant can express an amount derived from the current pool count multiplied by a fixed factor.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase random-table with item-destruction lifecycle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike involves: (a) spending a Magic action, (b) a 50% random chance the caster is transported to a different plane (escaping the blast), (c) Force damage scaled by remaining charges to all in a 30-ft emanation, and (d) the staff is permanently destroyed. The staff-breaking is a deliberate activation-triggered destruction, not a last-charge lifecycle event. The current surface has no activation phase that models deterministic item destruction on use.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Magic action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion..."
